I run a lean team and I check the work. If you inflate your numbers, recycle old or purchased lists and pass them off as fresh research, hand me unverified
s, or fabricate a report, I will find it and we will be done that day — no second chance. I am not interested in someone who sounds experienced. I want someone who can prove it on a screen recording before I hire them.

The role, straight



You own lead generation end to end. You pull targeted B2B leads from 
 for both US and international markets (including Australia, New Zealand, and Singapore), verify and clean them, load them into GoHighLevel correctly tagged and routed, and send me a data report every working day. No babysitting required — you run the process and tell me the truth about the results.



Hard requirements (these will be verified — don't claim what you can't show)



5+ years of active, hands-on lead generation experience in this exact type of role — not adjacent, not "I've used a tool once." Active means you've been doing it recently and continuously.


 power user. You can build ICP-targeted lists from scratch using filters, manage credits, run
 verification, control bounce rates, and export clean data. You'll demonstrate this live (see "How to apply").

GoHighLevel (GHL) hands-on experience. You can import contacts, map custom fields, dedupe, tag, and route leads into the right pipelines/workflows without creating a mess.

US and international sourcing. You know how the process changes between US and international markets — data availability, verification, and compliance (GDPR, anti-spam) — not just "I change the country filter."

Daily reporting discipline. You produce a clean data report every working day without being asked.

Strong written English and the ability to explain your own process in your own words.



What you'll actually do every day



Pull targeted leads from 
 against the ICP/segments I assign (US + international).

Filter and enrich for fit — title, industry, company size, region, technologies, etc.

Verify
s and keep bounce rates low; flag and discard junk rather than padding counts.

Export clean data and import it into GHL with correct field mapping.

Dedupe against existing GHL contacts so we never double-load.

Tag and route leads into the correct pipelines/workflows.

Send me a daily report (template below).

Keep the lists healthy — ongoing hygiene, not just dumping.



The full lead process you must own



Sourcing ? ICP filtering ? enrichment ?
/phone verification ? export ? GHL import with field mapping ? deduplication ? tagging & pipeline routing ? daily reporting ? list hygiene.



If any step in that chain is unfamiliar to you, you don't have the experience this role needs.



Daily report (this is roughly what I expect to see)



Total leads pulled today

Breakdown by segment and by region (US / International)

Verified
s vs. discarded

Phone coverage

New vs. duplicates removed

Count successfully imported to GHL + tags applied

Bounce rate / data quality notes

Any blockers



Real numbers only. A bad day reported honestly is fine. A good day that's made up is not.



How we work (the honesty part, in plain terms)



Transparency about your methods is required. You tell me exactly what tools and data sources you use — not just Apollo — and you tell me plainly whether you ever buy, scrape, or reuse lists. I'm not trying to trap you; I just won't tolerate being misled about how the leads were produced.

Reports must be truthful. Inflated counts, fake or unverified contacts, and copied-forward old data are instant disqualifiers, in hiring and after.

"I'm not sure" and "I made a mistake" are acceptable answers. Lying to cover it is not.



What I provide




 and GoHighLevel access

Clear ICPs and segments

Payment via Payoneer, on time

A boss who actually reviews the work and promotes people who earn it



How to apply (this is the screen — skip a step and you're out)



A 5–10 minute Loom/screen recording. Log into your own Apollo account (or a demo) and, live on screen, build a targeted list against this ICP: B2B fleet, industrial, and agricultural companies in the US plus Australia/New Zealand/Singapore that would buy tire sealant. Show the filters you choose and why, then show how you'd verify and export the data and prep it for a GHL import. I want to watch you actually do it, not hear you describe it.



Two professional references from past lead-gen roles, with contact details I can reach.

Answer the screening questions below in your own words. Copy-pasted or AI-generated boilerplate gets deleted.

Disclose every tool and data source you use beyond Apollo, and state plainly whether you buy, scrape, or recycle lists.

Be ready for a short paid test task (1–2 hours) before any ongoing commitment — real work, real pay, my real data quality standards.



Start your application with the word "SEALANT" so I know you read this all the way through.



Screening questions



Walk me through exactly how you build a targeted list in Apollo for the ICP above — which filters, in what order, and why.

How do you manage Apollo credits and
 verification to keep bounce rates low? What bounce rate do you consider acceptable?

What changes in your process between US and international (AU/NZ/Singapore) sourcing — data availability, verification, and compliance?

Describe your exact field mapping when importing Apollo data into GHL, and how you prevent duplicates and bad records.

How do you tag and route leads into GHL pipelines/workflows? Give a real example from past work.

What does your daily lead-gen report normally look like? Attach or describe a real sample.

Tell me about a time your lead numbers came back low or your list quality was bad. What did you actually do?



What gets you removed immediately



Fabricated or inflated reports · unverified or fake
s passed off as good · recycled/purchased lists presented as fresh research · skipping application steps · being vague or evasive about how the work was actually done.

title: Customer Success & Partnerships Coordinator Full remote
description:
About Us

Milkforbubs is a Singapore-based postpartum nutrition brand helping new mothers feel supported and nourished through lactation and recovery. We make products mothers actually want to eat — lactation cookies, brownies, granola, shakes, supplements, and electrolytes. We are a small, fast-moving team that cares deeply about the mothers we serve.



The Role

We are looking for a warm, organised, and driven Coordinator to be the heartbeat of our customer relationships and partnership execution. You will own the day-to-day experience of our customers and support outreach to partners, educators, and brands. This is a hands-on role — you will be calling real mothers, building real relationships, and making things happen.



What You Will Own



Customer Success

Call at least 1 customer daily to check in, gather feedback, and build loyalty

Be the first point of contact for delivery issues, complaints, and order queries, resolve warmly and promptly

Maintain a live error log for delivery and fulfilment issues and ensure appropriate compensation is actioned

Manage and grow the Milkforbubs VIP list, track top spenders monthly, coordinate freebies and discounts with ops, and personally call VIPs to inform them of new launches and events

Ensure all customer messages across channels (DMs,
, comments) are replied to in a warm and timely manner

Compile a weekly customer feedback summary for the Founder highlighting recurring themes, complaints, and praise



Partnerships — Execution

Follow up on partnership leads opened by the Founder — maintain a live tracker of all outreach, follow-ups, and outcomes

Coordinate with Mummy's Market on logistics, samples, giveaways, and feature placements

Reach out to aligned brands for giveaway and collab opportunities (using templates and scripts provided)

Liaise with lactation counsellors, dietitians, and doulas for content alignment and collaboration

Coordinate sample pack preparation and distribution logistics in partnership with operations

Support outreach to confinement food providers, nanny agencies, and postnatal massage therapists for sample distribution

Coordinate stroller brand and baby product brand partnerships for sample bag inclusion



TikTok Shop & Shopee Affiliate

Maintain affiliate tracker — ensure all active affiliates are onboarded, briefed, and monitored

Flag performance issues and escalate to Founder for strategic decisions



What You Will NOT Be Doing

To be clear about scope: this is a coordinator role, not a BD or strategy role.

You will not be cold-opening relationships with hospitals (KKH, Thomson, NUHS) — the Founder leads these

You will not negotiate or close brand partnership contracts

You will not make strategic decisions on product placement or pricing



Bonus Points

Experience in a DTC, F&B, or mother-and-baby brand

Familiarity with Shopee, TikTok Shop, or Shopify

Has been pregnant or is a mother herself — you get the community from the inside

Experience with CRM tools or customer tracking systems



Escalation Guide

You are empowered to resolve the following independently:

Delivery delays — offer discount code or resend (within approved limits)

Wrong item sent — coordinate replacement with ops

General complaints — acknowledge, apologise, resolve, log

Giveaway logistics and sample coordination



Escalate to Founder for:

Any compensation above SGD 50 in value

Media or press enquiries

Partnership proposals requiring a contract or formal agreement

Customer escalations involving legal threats or public complaints

Any hospital or healthcare institution outreach



What We Offer

A meaningful role in a brand that genuinely improves mothers' lives

Direct access to and mentorship from the Founder

Small team culture — your work is visible and your impact is real

Staff discount on all Milkforbubs products

Opportunity to grow into a senior role as the business scales



Working hours to follow Singapore working hours timing 8am-6pm with an hour break.

Do apply with the word "pineapple" in your resume/cover. Applicants without the word pineapple will not be considered.

Public holiday to follow Singapore's arrangement.

Please note that there will be a verbal reasoning test needed for this role

Please also note that we will require a voice note to be sent as role requires speaking directly to our customers.

Excellent attention to detail and strong numerical skills.



Ability to work independently and meet tender deadlines.



Reliable high-speed internet connection and suitable home office environment.

Commercial electrical projects.



Industrial electrical projects.

You do need to be comfortable with technology (specifically cybersecurity), quick to learn new tools, and be a creative critical thinker. Strong written English and attention to detail matter more than current technical depth.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will not do all of this on day one. We start with a few areas and add more as you ramp up and gather interest or expertise in certain areas. Over time the role may cover:



Content and marketing support

- Basic graphics generation using Canva or similar tools (social cards, blog headers)

Sales and lead generation support (research and prep only, B2B + B2C)

- Build and clean prospect lists (Apollo, public sources, given sources)

- Help build out the CRM and keep it tidy: data entry, tagging, removing duplicates

- Prepare short briefs on prospects before calls

- Track the pipeline and flag follow-ups that are due



Training platform support

- Triage and respond to support tickets (first response, then escalate to me)

- Build out FAQ and help documentation

- Test cybersecurity labs as a student and report broken steps or unclear instructions

- Help with onboarding
s for new users



Admin and back-office

- Inbox and calendar management

- Track tasks, renewals, and deadlines

- General research and document formatting



Other tasks as reasonable assigned.



As you learn each task, you write a short standard operating procedure (SOP) for it. Documenting how you work is part of the job, not extra. I value people who build clear, repeatable processes.



WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR

- Excellent written English

- Strong attention to detail

- Interested in cybersecurity

- Comfortable learning new software quickly

- Organized and able to manage your own task list

- Reliable and communicative. If something is unclear, you ask. If something breaks, you flag it early

- Honest about what you do and do not know

- Using AI to extend your thinking/brainstorming/research but not replace your understanding of concepts and ideas.



NICE TO HAVE (not required)

- Experience with any of: AI Tools, Graphic Design Tools, Notion, Sales & Marketing tools, or other automation tools.

- Experience supporting a small business or solo founder



LOGISTICS

- Hours: This role will start part-time with potential to grow to full-time as tasks ramp up.

- Schedule: mostly flexible, but some overlap with US Pacific time is preferred for quick questions and meetings.

- Rate: 3-4 USD per hr

- Confidentiality: you must be comfortable signing a standard confidentiality agreement (NDA)

- Long-term: I want someone to grow with the business, not a one-off task. Reliability and a long-term mindset are rewarded.



HOW TO APPLY



Read this carefully. Applications that skip these steps will be deleted.



1. Start your message with the word CYBER so I know you read the whole post.

2. In a few sentences, describe a process or system you set up or documented in a past role.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.

We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.

By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.

And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



This is not your typical Senior Financial Analyst role. You’ll work closely with our VP Finance and senior leadership team, helping to drive financial insight and discipline across one of Australia’s fastest growing companies.

You’ll play a key role in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting and business partnering, turning financial data into meaningful insights that support smart commercial decisions.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, ideal for someone who enjoys digging into the numbers, improving processes, and influencing business decisions.



You’ll be responsible for:



-Preparing monthly financial reports, dashboards and P&L analysis, including clear variance commentary

-Owning the budgeting and forecasting processes across multiple entities

-Building and maintaining financial models to support planning and decision-making

-Providing financial insights and analysis to support senior leadership and operational teams

-Partnering with State Leads and department heads to monitor performance and improve margins

-Assisting with reconciliations and financial data accuracy across systems

-Supporting compliance with BAS, PAYGW, FBT and other regulatory requirements

-Assisting with audit preparation and working with external auditors

-Identifying opportunities to improve financial processes and reporting efficiency

-Leading the implementation of automation, AI tools and improved reporting frameworks

-Report to Finance Manager and working closely with senior stakeholders



What will set you apart from other candidates:



-You’re analytical and commercially minded, able to turn data into meaningful insights

-You enjoy solving problems and improving processes

-You’re comfortable working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

-You’re highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities

-You take ownership and initiative, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement

-You’re curious and interested in leveraging technology and automation in finance



What you’ll bring:



-A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

-CPA, CA or CMA qualification (or working towards) highly regarded

-5+ years’ experience in financial analysis, reporting

-Strong experience with financial reporting, forecasting and variance analysis

-Advanced Excel / financial modelling skills

-Experience with Xero or similar accounting systems

-Strong communication skills and the ability to present financial insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders



What’s in it for you?



-This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

title: Travel Operations Coordinator / Itinerary Project Manager
description:
Travel Operations Coordinator / Itinerary Project Manager



Job Description

We are looking for an exceptionally detail-oriented, highly organized, and meticulous Travel Operations Coordinator / Itinerary Project Manager to help execute high-end surf travel experiences for our clients.



This is not a general travel agent sales role. Our team sells and designs the overall trip concept, and this role helps bring those trips to life through detailed planning, research, coordination, fact-checking, vendor communication, and itinerary execution.



The ideal candidate is a planner and project manager at heart — someone who loves details, checklists, logistics, timelines, clear communication, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



You will help take a simple trip outline and turn it into a complete, polished, highly detailed itinerary with every important step accounted for. This includes gathering essential information, confirming details with clients and vendors, researching travel logistics, checking drive times and transfer flow, coordinating reservations and activities, tracking deadlines, and helping ensure each trip runs smoothly from start to finish.



We are a boutique surf travel company that plans elevated, highly customized trips for families, couples, groups, and corporate clients. Our clients expect thoughtful planning, accurate information, beautiful trip flow, and excellent service. This role is essential to delivering that experience.



This is a remote position. A strong internet connection, excellent written English, and comfort using remote work tools are required. We use Zoho CRM, Zoho Projects, Zoho Cliq,
, shared documents, spreadsheets, and online research tools.



Key Responsibilities



 Trip Planning & Itinerary Execution

- Turn high-level trip outlines into detailed, step-by-step travel itineraries.

- Research and verify important trip details such as travel times, transfer logistics, activity timing, restaurant options, surf lesson schedules, check-in/check-out times, and destination-specific considerations.

- Help create smooth trip flow with realistic timing, appropriate buffers, and thoughtful sequencing of activities.

- Identify missing details, open questions, possible conflicts, and logistical issues before they become problems.

- Coordinate with hotels, villas, surf schools, guides, chefs, drivers, restaurants, wellness providers, and other travel partners.

- Gather and organize key information from vendors, including pricing, availability, inclusions, cancellation policies, payment terms, contact details, meeting points, and guest requirements.

- Assist with booking and confirming trip components such as transfers, surf lessons, activities, meals, spa appointments, restaurant reservations, and special requests.

- Maintain detailed trip notes, confirmations, deadlines, and task lists.

- Help prepare polished client-facing trip materials, including itineraries, proposals, booking documents, and travel guides.



Vendor & Partner Communication

- Communicate professionally with travel partners and vendors by
, WhatsApp, and other channels.

- Follow up consistently to collect missing information, confirmations, pricing, photos, menus, policies, and other required trip details.

- Track vendor responses and make sure all important information is documented clearly.

- Help compare vendor options and summarize findings for the team.

- Confirm all details before client travel, including dates, times, locations, inclusions, costs, contact information, and special requests.



Project Management & Operations

- Manage trip-related tasks inside Google Docs/Sheets, Zoho Projects, Zoho CRM and shared documents.

- Keep projects organized, updated, and moving forward.

- Create and maintain quality assurance and planning checklists, spreadsheets, timelines, and operational documents.

- Help ensure deadlines are met and no trip detail is missed.

- Support the team with administrative, research, and operational tasks as needed.

- Assist with improving internal systems, templates, SOPs, and planning processes over time.



The Type of Person We’re Looking For



You may be a great fit if you are:

- Extremely detail-oriented and naturally organized.

- A strong planner who enjoys logistics, structure, and checklists.

- Comfortable managing many moving parts at once.

- Proactive about spotting missing details, inconsistencies, and potential problems.

- Excellent at written English communication.

- Reliable, responsive, and consistent.

- Calm under pressure and able to work carefully without rushing.

- Comfortable asking thoughtful questions when something is unclear.

- Able to follow directions while also thinking critically and independently.

- Excited to help create exceptional travel experiences for clients.



This role requires someone who is meticulous. Small details matter. Dates, times, names, pricing, inclusions, policies, and logistics must be accurate.



Requirements & Skills

- Proven experience as a Virtual Assistant, Travel Planner, Project Coordinator, Event Planner, Executive Assistant, or similar role.

- Excellent written English communication skills.

- Strong research skills and ability to verify information from multiple sources.

- Strong organization and time management skills.

- Experience managing projects, timelines, checklists, or complex administrative workflows.

- Proficiency with Google Docs, Google Sheets, spreadsheets, and shared documents.

- Familiarity with online calendars and scheduling tools.

- Comfort using project management and CRM systems. Experience with Zoho CRM, Zoho Projects, or similar tools is a plus.

- Ability to work remotely with a reliable computer and strong internet connection.

- Experience in travel, hospitality, luxury service, events, or client-facing operations is a strong plus.



Nice-to-Have Experience

- Travel planning or itinerary creation.

- Hotel, villa, tour operator, or hospitality coordination.

- Event planning or wedding planning.

- Executive assistant work involving complex scheduling and logistics.

- Client service for premium or high-touch customers.

- Experience creating polished documents, proposals, or client-facing itineraries.

- Interest in travel, wellness, adventure, or boutique hospitality.



About Us

title: Outbound Calling Sales Person/Onboarding Manager
description:
I am the founder of an online marketplace platform that is similar to airbnb, except it's specifically designed for long-term-care facilities for the elderly and disabled. We serve Adult Family Homes, Assisted Living Facilities and Nursing Homes. When one of these homes has an empty room available for an elderly person, they can list it on our website with photos and pricing info. When a family needs to find care for an elderly parent, they can go on our site and search their city to see all the available rooms nearby. They can contact the business with any questions, schedule a tour, request a quote or book the room. 



We're looking for a friendly, patient and self motivated outbound caller with outstanding sales and English speaking skills. The ideal candidate is a very committed person seeking steady and long-term employment in a position that will help thousands of elderly people and small business owners. This position is full time. 



Job Description:



You will be cold-calling assisted living businesses to offer to list their available rooms on our website/platform for free - so that families can find them easier. 90% of the time, the people you will be speaking with are the business owners themselves. (The other 10% will be their employees.) Most facilities accept Medicaid clients. (Medicaid is a social service for low-income individuals. The government pays the cost of their care, but at a much lower price than private-pay) Business owners will have the option to post their Medicaid openings for free, or if they are looking for private pay clients, they can post their private pay openings on a monthly subscription (optional).



If they agree to sign up and list their room(s), you will start by creating an account for them. You will ask their name,
 and phone number. After you create an account for them, you'll then attach them as a user to their Organization profile. The next step is to ask them specific questions about their facility as you fill out their facility details such as Contact info, amenities, alcohol, tobacco, pets policies, equipment, and what they do or don't do at their facility. You'll then create two listings for them over the phone. One free Medicaid listing, and one Private Pay listing. The Medicaid listing will be published and live right away, but the private pay listing will stay unpublished. You'll ask them certain questions about about the room they have available, and about the services they offer, and what type of client they are looking for. You'll check all the boxes with their answers. 



You'll then ask them to get on our website either from their computer or phone, and you'll ask them to search their city from our homepage, and see how their listing looks. You will explain exactly how the entire process works, and instruct them where to click and exactly what to do. You'll explain how the free Medicaid listings work, and how the paid Private Pay subscriptions work. We have a very specific word-for-word script that you'll follow until you have the script and process memorized. Once you end the call, you'll send them a welcome
 with additional instructions. The
 will have instructions for setting a password, updating any of the facility information, adding photos, and starting a private pay subscription. They can either add photos themselves or
 you their photos, and you'll need to add them to their listings. You will update a spreadsheet with all the businesses you sign up every day. You will remain their point of contact in case they need any help on their account. 



When we call businesses this way, we sign up 1.5 - 2 new accounts/listings per hour, and you will have no problem doing the same within just the first few weeks. The difference between this position and a typical cold-calling sales/telemarketing position is that the majority of the businesses you will be calling are actually happy to hear from you and are excited that you will help them. They have a hard time filling their empty rooms, and there is no service quite like ours. There are no angry people yelling at us or hanging up the phone. 



Please note that the majority of business owners you call are not native English speakers. Most are immigrants from other countries, and may have limited English and limited experience with computers/internet/technology. This role requires absolute patience. These people have huge hearts for caring for elderly and disabled people, but require some patience with technology. They are usually very self-aware and will tell you they are not good at computers, and they're extremely grateful for our absolute patience in showing them how it all works and explaining in a way that they understand. 



Pay:



The pay is $1,000 month for full time 8 hours per day - plus commissions. While we are ok with the providers creating only free Medicaid listings, we definitely want them to list their private pay listings for the $199/monthly subscription. The $199/month gets them Google Ads, so they will get real google leads to see their listings and contact them directly to book their room. Most of their $199/month goes directly toward Google Ads. 



Your commission on every single paid subscription is $10. Most clients do not pay for a subscription on-the-spot over the phone, but instead they subscribe in the weeks following your phone call. If a business that you called and signed up pays for a subscription within 3 months of your phone call, you will earn the $10 commission. Every month that they stay subscribed, you will keep getting the $10 commission. Once they find a client and fill their room, they can unsubscribe and remove their ad. If another room becomes available later, and they subscribe again to advertise their opening, you will get the same $10 commission again every month - as long as they re-subscribe within 7 months of ending their first subscriptions. These businesses get an opening every 3-4 months. The average time it takes for them fill a room is 4-6 months. 



Payday is twice a month around the 1st and the 16th using Payoneer.



Trial Period:



After the initial training period, you'll start the calls at your own pace on your own. We need to see some of your accounts start signing up for the paid subscriptions as you get more confident and improve. There's a learning curve and the script can be difficult to memorize at first, but overall we'll monitor your sign ups and subscriptions over 2 - 3 months after training. We will know in the first few weeks if you are struggling badly, and will support you with as much additional training as needed. We are patient and willing to spend extra time with you as long as we're seeing improvements. If it looks like you're struggling with no noticeable improvement, or are far below the average with sign-ups, we may end your employment. This has never happened with anyone, but still worth mentioning. 



Training:



I will be training you personally along with our sales director William. He is also Filipino, and has been working with us for over 2 years. We can get on video calls with you as you listen to my calls or William's calls, and watch our screen for the entire calls. You can ask any and all questions in between calls. We'll also send you hours of screen-recorded samples of successful calls to watch and memorize. You can access our Test website and create practice accounts to get used to the software navigation. We will be hiring 3 people for this role, and you'll have the ability to practice doing mock calls with each other to get comfortable with the script. It is a fairly long script because it goes from signing them up, updating their facility info, listing their rooms, to you leading an interactive website demo that they follow along as you explain to them how it all works. It will require some practice, memorization and patience to get comfortable. If you apply for this position, please mention "the assisted living marketplace". Once you're comfortable, you can start calling people as we listen in and watch your screen. If you prefer to record your calls, instead of having us monitor live, that works too. Then you will continue on your own with periodic check-ins from William or myself. Any questions you ever have, you can text or
 myself or William. 



Requirements:



Eagerness to memorize the script and process, honesty, patience and communication. We want you to do well and we will continue to train you as long as needed for you to succeed. If you're struggling with anything, please don't be shy or embarrassed or try to hide it. We want to help! We can only succeed if you're succeeding. I've failed more than anyone, and nobody is going to judge you or be mean to you. 



Outstanding English speaking skills and genuine friendly personality.



Our approach is very different from typical cold call sales positions and we will train you until you're a master.



Fast reliable Internet, computer and a smart-phone is required. We will provide access to virtual phone numbers through QUO app that you can call/text from. We will also set you up with a company
 that you can
 from and give to your customers in case they need any further assistance from you with their account.



Benefit/PTO



You will get 13th month pay in December. In the first year, it the bonus will be relative to the number of months you worked in that first year. 



You will get 15 days PTO that you choose. You can only take PTO days after 90 days of working unless pre-approved during interview process. 



There will be 7 additional US holidays that will be paid including Christmas, New Years Day, Thanksgiving, Independence Day, Labor Day, Veterans Day, Memorial Day.



Time Zone:



Our company is near Seattle, WA USA and the Time Zone is Pacific Time. The calling/working hours are between 8am - 5pm Pacific time. This is a full time position for 8 hrs per day. You can choose which 8 hrs to work as long as it's Mon - Fri within 8am - 5pm Pacific.



If you wish to apply for this position, please provide an English voice sample with your application saying the following lines:



"Hi, I was calling to 

see if you guys have a

room available?"



"Perfect! I work with families, with hospitals, and with Medicaid to help you get clients without agencies or referral fees. We have a website where we list Adult Family Homes that have current openings. Would you be against me adding your availability to our site?"



If you have any questions or if there's anything I missed, please let me know.



Thank you!

Vitaly

 response workflows: triage ? scope ? containment ? post-i
 notes

title: WANTED: The World's Most Relentless Growth-Focused SEO Account Manager
description:
When you apply, make sure the subject line is: Rankings Don't Lie

(see rest of application details at end of job description)



Who We Are

Blue Crocus Solutions is not your typical SEO agency.

We don't hide behind algorithm updates.

We don't blame Google when rankings fall.

We don't send pretty reports while client accounts quietly decline.

We help home service companies dominate their local markets through technical SEO, Local SEO, content strategy, authority building, and relentless execution.

Our clients are plumbers, junk removal companies, dumpster rental businesses, demolition contractors, roofers, and other home service businesses that depend on leads to feed their families and grow their companies.

We're a team of builders.

We build rankings.

We build systems.

We build leaders.

Most importantly, we take ownership.

When something goes wrong, we don't look for someone to blame. We look for the root cause and build a solution.

We're growing quickly and looking for someone who shares that mindset.

Not someone who wants another SEO job.

Someone who wants ownership.



What We're Looking For

We are not looking for someone who manages tasks.

We are looking for someone who owns outcomes.

The type of person who takes it personally when rankings drop.

The type of person who treats client businesses like their own.

The type of person who refuses to stop digging until they find the root cause of a problem.

As a Growth-Focused SEO Account Manager, you will take ownership of 10–15 client accounts and eventually grow to managing 15–20 accounts independently.

You will be the quarterback of those accounts.

You won't always personally execute every task.

You will make sure the right tasks are identified, assigned, completed properly, quality checked, and producing results.

You'll oversee strategy, technical SEO, content, authority building, local SEO, reporting, and client communication.

You'll identify opportunities.

You'll solve problems.

You'll communicate proactively.

Most importantly, you'll make sure every account moves forward every month.



Key Responsibilities



Account Ownership

- Own the performance and health of 10–15 SEO accounts

- Lead onboarding and strategy development

- Build and maintain account growth plans

- Identify opportunities and risks before they become problems

- Maintain accurate account documentation, task updates, and client records to ensure visibility across Finance, Operations, and Fulfillment teams.



Technical SEO

- Conduct technical audits and understand website technicals at a deep level

- Identify crawl issues, indexing, site structure, schema, internal linking, and performance issues

- Implement simple website fixes directly in WordPress

- Coordinate larger technical tasks with specialists

- Quality control completed work



Content Strategy & On-Page SEO

- Plan content strategies

- Order content from our internal team of writers

- Review content for quality, search intent, structure, and SEO best practices, but most of all, usefulness to the end user

- Ensure proper internal linking and topical authority

- Identify content gaps and growth opportunities



Local SEO & Authority Building

- Oversee Google Business Profile optimization

- Monitor citation and local SEO efforts

- Oversee backlink acquisition campaigns

- Identify new authority-building opportunities



Client Communication

- Provide proactive updates and communication

- Share wins, opportunities, completed work, and upcoming plans

- Conduct strategy discussions and review calls

- Build long-term client trust



Continuous Improvement

- Bring new ideas to the table

- Stay current on SEO trends and testing

- Build SOPs when new processes emerge

- Help improve the agency's systems and execution



Qualifications, Skills & Experience



Non-Negotiable

- Strong understanding of Technical SEO

- Strong understanding of Local SEO

- Strong understanding of content strategy

- Experience managing SEO campaigns

- Experience working inside WordPress

- Strong written and verbal English communication

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Exceptional attention to detail



Required Tool Experience



You should already be comfortable using:

- Ahrefs

- Google Search Console

- Google Analytics 4

- Screaming Frog

- BrightLocal

- Looker Studio



Bonus Points

- You've built and ranked your own websites

- You've run rank-and-rent projects

- You've built affiliate sites

- You've tested SEO theories on your own properties

- You've managed home service SEO campaigns

- You've built AI-assisted workflows without sacrificing quality



Frankly, we'd rather talk to someone with two years of experience who has ranked their own assets than someone with five years of agency experience who has never built anything themselves.



Salary & Growth Opportunities

This position starts at: $1,500 USD per month

Compensation will grow as you prove your ability to own accounts, drive results, and contribute to the growth of the agency.



Successful candidates will have opportunities to grow into:

- Senior SEO Account Manager

- SEO Team Lead

- SEO Operations Manager

- SEO Director



You'll be evaluated on:

- Client retention

- Organic traffic growth

- Lead growth

- Communication quality

- Initiative

- Problem-solving ability

- Account health

- Process improvement



Our goal is for your portfolio of accounts to consistently achieve meaningful organic growth through disciplined execution and continuous improvement.



The Type of Person Who Thrives Here

You are proactive.

You communicate early.

You communicate often.

You don't disappear when problems show up.

You run toward them.

You probably have side projects you play on to practice SEO.

You probably test things on your own websites.

You probably spend time reading, testing, building, and experimenting outside of work.

When rankings drop, you don't immediately blame an algorithm update, you investigate.

When a client is frustrated, you don't make excuses, you create a plan.

When a process breaks, you don't patch it, you improve it.

The best people in this role are bulldogs. They don't stop at symptoms. They latch onto the problem until they find root causes.

Then they build systems that prevent those problems from happening again.



This Role Is NOT For You If...

You blame Google updates every time rankings drop

You need someone checking on you constantly

You wait to be told what to do

You struggle with communication

You avoid accountability

You use AI without fact-checking

You disappear when problems arise

You care more about completing tasks than producing results

You think publishing content alone is SEO



Make Sure You're Comfortable With...

Remote Work- You must have reliable internet, reliable power, and a professional work environment.



Ownership

You will be responsible for client outcomes.

We don't expect perfection.

We do expect ownership.



Communication

Problems rarely destroy client relationships.

Silence does.

If rankings drop, tell us.

If a deadline is slipping, tell us.

If a client is frustrated, tell us.

If you made a mistake, tell us.



60-Day Trial Period

Every new hire begins with a paid 60-day trial period to ensure we're the right fit for each other.



Our Values -  will you be joining the CREW?

C — Communicate with Clarity, Courage and Connection

We communicate early, honestly, and directly.

R — Relentless Pursuit of Growth, Grounded in Excellence

You will function as the business owner of the Offer Nest "Agent Model" pipeline. Your primary objective is to generate consistent deal flow, negotiate contracts with real estate agents, and manage the end-to-end disposition process. You are an entrepreneur with a proven track record, looking for an established infrastructure, brand, and capital-ready pipeline to maximize your own income potential.



Scope of Responsibilities

Complete Operational Authority: Manage 100% of the daily business operations. You are the final decision-maker on lead qualification, offer submission, and contract negotiation.



Aggressive Outreach: Execute high-volume communication (outbound calling, SMS follow-up, and
) specifically targeting real estate agents to secure properties under contract.



Pipeline Management: Utilize our established CRM and lead scraping tools to nurture a high-intent pipeline. You are responsible for ensuring every lead is qualified and moved toward a closing.



Disposition & Closing: Coordinate with buyers and agents to ensure contracts close on time. You are responsible for the entire life cycle of the deal.



Performance Reporting: Maintain full transparency by tracking and reporting on KPIs (Leads contacted, Contracts signed, Assignment fees generated) on a weekly basis.



Requirements & Qualifications

Proven Closing Ability: You must have a demonstrable history of closing real estate deals. You are comfortable handling tough objections from agents and know how to get to a "Yes."

Entrepreneurial Mindset: You treat this business as your own. You do not wait for instructions; you identify bottlenecks and solve them independently.



Communication Mastery: You possess world-class verbal and written communication skills. You are persuasive, articulate, and can build rapport with agents instantly.



Tech Literacy: You are proficient in managing a CRM, SMS automation tools, and lead management workflows. You understand how to leverage data to work smarter.

Self-Management: You are highly disciplined and capable of managing a fully remote operation without direct supervision.



Compensation & Partnership Structure

This is a 100% Performance-Based Partnership. There is no hourly wage or salary.

Direct Revenue Split: You will be compensated via a direct percentage of the Gross Assignment Fee for every deal you close. This ensures that your income is directly tied to your output.

License Ownership: You are granted the license to operate under the Offer Nest brand and utilize our proprietary infrastructure.



Growth Incentive: We are looking for a partner who wants to scale their earnings. Your income potential is capped only by your ability to close.



Why Partner with Offer Nest?

Ready-to-Use Infrastructure: You don't have to build the tech stack. You are stepping into a proven system (CRM, SMS automation, scraping tools) designed for the Agent Model.

Autonomy: This is your ship to sail. We are looking for a partner who wants the freedom of ownership without the headache of building a company from the ground up.

title: Apparel Graphic Designer | T-Shirt Designs, Typography & Ecommerce Product Concepts
description:
Apparel Graphic Designer | T-Shirt Designs, Typography & Ecommerce Product Concepts



We are looking for a talented part-time Apparel Graphic Designer to help create original apparel designs for a growing ecommerce brand.



This role is focused on creating strong, marketable designs for t-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts, hats, patches, and other apparel-based products.



The main goal is to create more high-quality design concepts so we can test more product listings, identify what customers respond to, and eventually develop winning signature products.



This is not a general VA role. This is not mainly a social media role. We are looking for a designer who can create original product graphics that look good, feel wearable, and have ecommerce selling potential.



Main Priority: Apparel Design



The main focus of this role is creating original apparel graphics.



You should be able to design:



* T-shirt graphics

* Hoodie and sweatshirt designs

* Typography-based apparel designs

* Badge and patch-style graphics

* Statement designs

* Faith-forward designs

* Patriotic designs

* Local/city/state-inspired designs

* Vintage-inspired graphics

* Clean minimalist apparel concepts

* Product design variations and colorways



We are looking for someone with strong taste in typography, layout, spacing, and wearable product design.



Brief Workflow



In many cases, we will provide the niche, phrase, theme, product idea, or general direction.



From there, your job will be to create multiple design concepts based on that direction. We will review the designs, give feedback, choose the strongest ones, and continue refining from there.



Some designs may be used for test listings to see what customers respond to. Winning designs may eventually become signature products or part of a larger collection.



We are looking for someone who can take a rough idea and turn it into strong, sellable apparel design options.



What We Need From You



You should be able to:



* Create original designs from scratch

* Create multiple design concepts from one idea

* Understand current apparel design trends

* Understand what looks good on t-shirts, hoodies, and hats

* Use strong typography and layout

* Create clean, production-friendly artwork

* Follow brand direction and references

* Take feedback and revise quickly

* Create mockups to show how designs look on products

* Organize files clearly

* Deliver designs consistently



We do not need overly complicated artwork. We need clean, strong, marketable designs that people would actually want to wear.



Design Style We Like



Our preferred style may include:



* Clean typography

* Premium minimal design

* Vintage-inspired apparel graphics

* Collegiate / athletic-style layouts

* Badge-style designs

* Strong statement designs

* Faith-forward concepts

* Patriotic concepts

* Local pride / city-inspired concepts

* Simple but impactful visuals



We do not want designs that look generic, overly cluttered, copied, or like basic template work.



Production Awareness



You do not need to handle final production or POD setup.



However, you should understand that designs need to work on real products. Designs should be clean enough for apparel printing, embroidery, patches, or product mockups when needed.



You should avoid artwork that is too thin, too detailed, hard to read, or difficult to produce.



Tools



You may use tools such as:



* Adobe Illustrator

* Photoshop

* Canva

* Kittl

* Figma

* Procreate

* AI design tools

* Or similar design software



We care more about the final result than the exact tool, but designs must look professional and be delivered in usable file formats.



File Deliverables



Depending on the project, we may ask for:



* PNG with transparent background

* SVG, PDF, AI, or editable source file when available

* Product mockup preview

* Organized design files

* Font names or design notes when needed

* Colorway variations



Helpful Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* T-shirt design

* Apparel brands

* Etsy products

* Shopify products

* Print-on-demand products

* Kittl or Canva apparel design

* Typography design

* Merch design

* Hat or patch design

* Ecommerce product mockups



This role is focused on creating apparel designs and product concepts.



Hours & Schedule



This is a flexible part-time role to start.



Hours are flexible and negotiable depending on your skill level, availability, communication, and quality of work.



We may hire more than one designer because we want to test more product ideas and build a stronger design pipeline.



We are looking for someone creative, dependable, detail-oriented, and consistent.



The right person understands that ecommerce apparel is about testing ideas, improving designs, and finding products that customers actually want to buy.



We want designers who can bring ideas to life, create strong product concepts, and help us build a bigger pipeline of testable apparel designs.

title: Operations & Client Support Assistant
description:
VFactor Health is a premium, clinical-grade online health-coaching program founded by Veronica Yu, a Registered Dietitian (RD) and Physician Assistant (PA). We're hiring a GoHighLevel Operations & Client Support VA — the organized generalist who keeps the day-to-day of a high-ticket coaching business running smoothly.



About VFactor Health

We help women 45–65 — on GLP-1 medications or considering them — lose fat, preserve muscle, manage side effects, and reduce long-ter
dication dependence, delivered as health coaching, education, and support. Our clients invest several thousand dollars in our programs, so every touchpoint has to feel organized, personal, and professional.



The Role

Think part executive assistant, part client-support lead, part CRM/ops coordinator, with solid working knowledge of GoHighLevel (GHL). You'll keep the CRM clean, clients moving smoothly from booking through onboarding, the inbox answered, the files organized, and the founder's day handled — and you'll document how it all works so the business runs the same whether or not anyone's watching.



When something needs deep automation building, we bring in a specialist GHL contractor. Your job is to operate the system well, not to build complex workflows from scratch. You'll work directly with the founder/CEO and the operations lead, so reliability, judgment, and clear communication matter as much as any single skill.



What You'll Do

GoHighLevel operations

- Manage contacts and pipelines in GHL — keep records accurate, move contacts through stages, tag/segment correctly, and keep the CRM clean and trustworthy.

- Coordinate client onboarding and appointments — schedule, confirm, reschedule, and follow up so nothing falls through the cracks.

- Basic workflow troubleshooting — spot when an automation, calendar, or sequence isn't firing, do simple fixes, and clearly escalate anything complex to our GHL automation contractor.

Client support & communication

- Be the friendly, professional front line across the inbox,
, and SMS — answer client and prospect questions promptly in our warm, clinical-but-approachable brand voice, and route anything clinical to the right coach.

- Keep response times fast and follow-ups consistent.

- Executive assistance (to the CEO)

- Calendar management, inbox triage, scheduling, and task/loose-end follow-up for the founder.

- Light project coordination — keep tasks, people, and deadlines on track.

Documentation & reporting

- Google Drive organization & document management — clean folder structure, consistent naming, easy-to-find documents.

- Spreadsheet and reporting updates — keep trackers and simple reports current and accurate.

- SOP documentation — record processes with Loom and write clear step-by-step Google Docs SOPs.



Who You Are

Above all: exceptionally organized, reliable, and proactive. You catch the details, follow through without being chased, and bring order to a fast-moving business.



You bring:

- Experience supporting an online digital agency and/or a high-ticket coach / info-product business — you understand the pace and client expectations. This is what we care about most.

- Working knowledge of GoHighLevel — comfortable in contacts, pipelines, calendars, and basic workflows; you can operate and lightly troubleshoot GHL.

- Excellent written English and a genuine customer-service mindset — clear, warm, professional, and quick in client-facing communication.

- Fluency with Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets) and Loom, plus comfort learning new tools quickly.

- Self-management and remote-work discipline — you manage your time, hit deadlines, and communicate proactively, with strong daily overlap with U.S. business hours.

- Nice to have (not required)

- Familiarity with Typeform, Slack, Zoom, Calendly, DocuSign,
 platforms (Klaviyo/Mailchimp), or light QuickBooks.

- Background in health, wellness, fitness, or coaching.

- Light SOP / process-improvement instincts.

- You do not need to be an advanced automation developer. If your passion is building complex GHL/n8n/Zapier automations, that's a different role on our team — this one is about running operations cleanly and supporting the founder.



This role isn't for you if…

- You need detailed step-by-step direction for everything and don't take ownership.

- You're disorganized or inconsistent with follow-through.

- You want to spend your day building complex automations rather than operating and supporting.

- You're slow or unclear in written client communication.



What We Offer

- A central, high-trust seat working directly with a clinician-founder at a fast-growing health brand.

- A varied, never-boring role spanning operations, client experience, and executive support.

100% remote and flexible, with the stability of a foundational operations hire.

- The chance to build and own the SOPs and systems the whole team relies on.

mbers

We are looking for a highly engaged, dedicated tea
mber to handle a healthy client load. We strongly prefer candidates for whom this is their only job. Proven experience performing bookkeeping for US-based businesses.

Reliable Infrastructure: You must have a highly reliable internet connection and dependable electricity to ensure consistent daily communication and workflow.



A proactive, tech-savvy mindset and excitement for learning AI-driven workflows.



Why Work With Us?



Stability: We pay a competitive, guaranteed fixed salary of $120 to $140 USD per week depending on your level of US bookkeeping experience. This provides you with highly reliable, steady income without the stress of fluctuating hourly tracking.



Respect: We foster an environment where asking questions is encouraged. Staying quiet when you need help is the only way to fail here.

title: Quality Engineer (Remote)
description:
We're a metal fabrication and import company that supplies precision-machined metal parts to customers in North America. Our engineering and manufacturing team is in China; our customers are in North America. We're looking for a Philippines-based Quality Engineer to sit between the two — making sure the parts our China team produces match what our North American customers asked for, and keeping both sides aligned on quality.



In short: you're the bridge between our China operations and our North American customers.



What you'll do

• Act as the main quality contact connecting our China team and our North American customers

• Check First Article Inspection (FAI) reports against customer drawings to confirm every dimension and feature is within tolerance

• Read engineering drawings and 3D CAD models — some dimensions come from the 3D model, not the 2D drawing — and understand GD&T

• Review drawings and parts for manufacturability, including identifying potential production, tolerance, material, or inspection issues before manufacturing

• Review supplier measurement data and process capability (Cpk) studies

• Check material certificates and Certificates of Conformance (COC) against the spec

• When parts don't conform, work with the China team to fix it and follow through — keeping the customer informed along the way

• Keep clear, organized quality records



What you'll need

• Engineering degree (Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, or related)

• Quality (QA/QC) experience in machining, manufacturing, or metal fabrication

• Experience with manufacturability review is a must

• Able to read mechanical drawings and 3D models, and understand GD&T (ASME Y14.5 or ISO)

• Strong written and spoken English — you'll deal with both our China team and North American customers daily

• Detail-oriented and able to work independently in a remote setting



Nice to have (not required)

• Experience working with factories in China

• Familiarity with Cpk/process capability, FAI, or PPAP

• Comfortable with Excel and AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to work efficiently



Details

• Type: Full-time

• Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

• Compensation: USD 1000/month to start

description:

 marketing. We have real clients and real results — this is an established agency, not a startup figuring things out.



I'm looking for one sharp appointment setter to become an extension of my team: someone who does LinkedIn outreach on behalf of the agency, starts genuine conversations with business owners, identifies the warm ones, and books them onto my calendar. 



You won't be closing sales — that's my job. Your job is to open doors and hand me people who are ready to talk.



This is not for someone who has done "a little" appointment setting. I need someone who knows how to engage, follow up without being annoying, read when a person is interested, and move them toward a conversation. If you disappear after the first message or just blast templates, this isn't the role for you.



What You'll Do:

- Run daily outreach to business owners on LinkedIn (from a Peripheral Media profile — not impersonating me)

- Start real conversations, not copy-paste spam — you'll have a framework, but you need to sound human

- Follow up consistently and intelligently with people who don't reply right away

- Offer our free account "audit" as the door-opener — it's how we show value before any pitch

- Spot the warm leads, qualify them lightly, and book them directly onto my calendar

- Keep our tracking sheet clean and up to date so nothing falls through the cracks



Who I'm Looking For:

- Proven appointment-setting or sales-development experience (tell me your numbers, show me results)

- Excellent written English — natural, warm, professional, not robotic

- Genuinely good with people: you can read tone, sense interest, and know when to push vs. back off

- Persistent and organized — follow-up is where most setters fail; this is where you'll win

- Comfortable on LinkedIn and learning our outreach approach

- Self-starter who takes ownership, not someone who needs to be told every step — think on your own.



What I Offer:

- A supportive, respectful team — I already work with several VAs long-term and treat people well

- ~20 hours/week to start, with room to grow as results come in

- $5/hour base, PLUS commission that rewards quality :

 + $10 bonus for every qualified appointment that actually shows up

 + One-time 3% bonus on any new project landed from a lead you sourced

- Clear systems, clear expectations, and direct access to me — no confusing layers of management

- Long-term stability — I want one good person I can keep, not constant turnover. The better your bookings, the more you earn.



How to Apply:

Start your message with the word "DOORS" so I know you read this fully. Then tell me:

- Your appointment-setting experience and your best result (real numbers). [Ex:  XX booked / month, ~XX% show rate]

- One example of how you turned a cold or hesitant prospect into a booked meeting

- Your availability and your expected hourly rate

title: MSP IT Support Technician
description:
MSP IT Support Technician — Job Description

About Us

We are a small, family-oriented Managed Services Provider based in Northern California, USA. Our team is made up of just two to three people, and we treat each other like family — not like numbers on an org chart. We work closely together every single day, helping each other solve problems, sharing knowledge, and making sure no one is ever left to figure things out alone. If you have ever wanted to be part of a team where you truly matter, where your contributions are noticed and appreciated, and where the people you work with genuinely care about you — this is that place.

 

We pride ourselves on the deep, lasting relationships we build with our clients. Our customers are not just ticket numbers or account names. They are small business owners, professionals, and teams who depend on us every day to keep their technology running smoothly. We take that trust seriously. Every interaction we have with a customer is an opportunity to show them that they are valued, heard, and appreciated. We do not just fix problems — we make people feel taken care of. That philosophy is at the heart of everything we do, and it is the single most important quality we look for in every person who joins our team.

 

The Role

We are hiring an MSP IT Support Technician to join our small, close-knit team. This is a full-time, work-from-home position. You will be the friendly, knowledgeable voice and presence our customers interact with when they need help. Your primary responsibility will be to field incoming support requests from customers via phone calls,
s, and text messages, turn those requests into organized tickets in our system, and then work to resolve them — either on your own or by collaborating closely with the rest of the team.

 

This is not a siloed role where you are handed a queue and left to grind through it alone. You will be working side by side with the team throughout the day, communicating constantly, asking questions, sharing ideas, and leaning on each other to deliver the best possible outcomes for our customers. We believe that the best support comes from a team that actually talks to each other, and we have built our workflow around that belief.

 

Working Hours

Your working hours will be 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Monday through Friday, Los Angeles, California time (Pacific Time). You must be available and at your desk during these hours. Our customers operate on this schedule, and being reachable and responsive during their business day is essential to the role.

 

Key Responsibilities

Customer Communication & Support Intake

Answer incoming phone calls from customers who are reaching out for technical support. You will be the first point of contact for many of our clients, so a warm, patient, and professional phone presence is essential. Monitor and respond to support requests received via
 and text message throughout the workday. For each request, gather all relevant details from the customer — what the issue is, when it started, what they have already tried, and any other information that will help us solve the problem efficiently. Create well-organized, detailed support tickets in our ticketing system for every request, ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks and that the team has the information needed to start working the issue immediately.

 

Issue Resolution & Troubleshooting

Work through support tickets to diagnose and resolve technical issues across a variety of client environments. Typical issues you will encounter include workstation and laptop problems, printer and peripheral connectivity,
 and Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, network and internet connectivity issues, password resets and account lockouts, software installation and configuration, VPN and remote access problems, and basic server and infrastructure alerts. You will not be expected to know everything or solve every problem on your own. Part of your job is knowing when to ask for help and collaborating with teammates to find the right answer. We solve problems together.

 

Ticket Management & Documentation

Keep tickets updated with clear, thorough notes so that any tea
mber can pick up where you left off. Document the steps you took, what you found, and what was done to resolve the issue. Maintain accurate records within our systems, including client assets, configurations, and procedures. Good documentation is what allows our small team to operate efficiently and deliver consistent, high-quality support across all of our clients.

 

Team Collaboration & Continuous Learning

Participate actively in daily team communication — whether that is a quick call, a group chat message, or a screen-sharing session to work through a tough problem together. Share what you learn with the team so that we all grow together. Stay current on the technologies and platforms our clients use, and be open to learning new tools and systems as our client base evolves.

 

What We Are Looking For

Required

Previous experience in IT helpdesk or technical support, whether in an internal IT department or at a Managed Services Provider. We are not looking for a specific number of years — we are looking for someone who genuinely knows their way around common IT support scenarios and can hit the ground running with real-world troubleshooting skills.

Familiarity with the day-to-day realities of MSP work. If you have previously worked at an MSP, you already understand the pace, the variety, the multi-client juggling act, and the importance of documentation and ticket hygiene. That experience is a big plus.

Strong English communication skills. You will be communicating directly with our customers through
, text, and phone calls. Your English must be clear, professional, and easy to understand. You should be comfortable writing detailed
s, carrying on a natural phone conversation, and adjusting your tone depending on the situation — whether it is a calm explanation to a frustrated user or a friendly check-in after resolving an issue.

A genuinely friendly, patient, and positive personality. This is not optional and it is not a soft requirement — it is central to who we are as a company. Our customers need to feel appreciated and taken care of every time they interact with us. If you are the kind of person who naturally puts people at ease, who stays calm under pressure, and who actually enjoys helping others, you will thrive here.

Reliability and consistency. You need to be at your desk, ready to work, during our business hours every day. Our customers depend on us being available, and your teammates depend on you being present and engaged.

A reliable home office setup including a stable, high-speed internet connection (at least 25 Mbps), a quiet workspace free from background noise during phone calls, and a computer capable of running multiple remote access sessions and browser tabs simultaneously.

A headset with a quality microphone for clear voice communication on customer phone calls.



Preferred (Nice to Have, Not Required)

Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and Entra ID (Azure AD).

Familiarity with RMM and PSA tools such as Atera, NinjaOne, or similar platforms.

Working knowledge of Windows Server environments, Active Directory, and Group Policy.

Basic networking knowledge — understanding of DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewall basics, and general LAN/WAN connectivity troubleshooting.

Experience with backup and disaster recovery platforms such as Veeam, Acronis, or similar solutions.

Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, or Microsoft certifications.

Experience using a ticketing system and understanding of basic ticket lifecycle management.



What It Is Like to Work With Us

We are not a large, impersonal company. We are a handful of people who genuinely like each other, look out for each other, and want to see each other succeed. When you join our team, you are not filling a seat — you are becoming part of something small and meaningful. Your work will be visible. Your impact will be felt. And the relationships you build with our customers will matter, because those relationships are the foundation of our business.

 

We maintain a positive, friendly, and collaborative work environment and it is a high priority for us that every tea
mber contributes to that culture. We want people who are likeable, who bring good energy, and who make the people around them — teammates and customers alike — feel better for having interacted with them. If that sounds like you, we would genuinely love to hear from you.

 

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive monthly salary in USD

Paid time off

13th-month pay

Permanent work-from-home setup — no commute, no dress code, just a comfortable place to do great work.

A supportive team that actually has your back.

title: Inbound Appointment Setter - Commercial Construction | Remote | Full-Time
description:

Our founder Rob Welch has been part of over $143M in commercial work and brings real projects directly to contractors. We're growing fast and building out our team.

This isn't a script-reading role. We want someone who can hold a real conversation, handle pushback, and get the booking without being pushy.

* Experience in construction, home services, or a related trade industry is strongly preferred

* GoHighLevel CRM (GHL) experience is strongly preferred

* Strong spoken English (barely to no accent) as you'll be speaking with US-based business owners all day

* Proven background in appointment setting, SDR work, or inbound sales

* Someone who doesn't fold on objections - you need to be comfortable holding your ground calmly and confidently

* Growth mindset - we do daily training and expect you to get better every week

* Reliable internet, quiet setup, available US eastern business hours

* Full-time availability - this is not a side gig 

* Able to be on the phone for 6-8+ hours per day without burning out

* Book 10-15 qualified meetings daily 





Compensation:



* Performance-based: $100 per closed deal 

* OTE $1,500–$2,000+/month for someone who is consistent and hungry

* Base pay of $500/month guaranteed: this covers you while you’re ramping up

* The base is a safety net, not a ceiling. Top performers earn well above OTE through volume

Your experience in appointment setting or sales

How do you handle it when someone pushes back on a call?

The status bonus — how it works:



Set 12+ qualified appointments in a month and you unlock a percentage of every deal that closes the following month — regardless of when you originally set those leads.



Hit 12 = 10%

Hit 16 = 15%

Hit 20 = 20%

description:

Overview 

American Standard Adhesives (ASA), a US-based distributor of hot melt adhesive solutions for B2B industries is looking for a self-starter Project Manager & Writer to execute the marketing initiatives laid out by our Marketing Manager. You will take full ownership of each project from kickoff through completion — driving the work forward independently between milestones and deliverables that the Marketing Manager will check at each step. title: Shopify Ecommerce Web Designer: Figma / Theme-Based Design
description:
About us:



Tomorrow Studios is a Shopify design and implementation studio based in British Columbia, Canada. We help ecommerce brands design, migrate, launch, and improve Shopify stores.



Our work includes Shopify website design, theme customization, platform migrations, app configuration, Shopify POS, B2B commerce, and ongoing ecommerce support.



We are a small team with high standards for design quality, communication, and practical execution.



About the role:



We are looking for a Shopify-focused ecommerce web designer who can create polished, practical, conversion-minded website designs in Figma.



This is not a generic graphic design role, and it is not primarily a development role.



The ideal candidate understands ecommerce websites, product pages, collection pages, homepage structure, mobile design, content hierarchy, and how Shopify themes are built using sections, blocks, templates, metafields, and app integrations.



You should be able to design attractive websites that are realistic to build within Shopify theme frameworks.



You will work closely with our team and developers, turning briefs into clear, buildable designs, so fast communication and a tight feedback loop matter as much as the work itself.



Responsibilities:



1. Design Shopify website pages and sections in Figma

2. Create homepage, collection page, product page, cart, about, FAQ, landing page, and content page designs

3. Design within the constraints of Shopify themes and theme frameworks

4. Create mobile-first, responsive layouts

5. Organize Figma files clearly for developer handoff

6. Design reusable sections and components that can be implemented in Shopify

7. Work from client briefs, brand assets, reference sites, product catalogues, and internal direction

8. Support revisions based on client and team feedback

9. Identify when a design can be built with native theme settings versus when custom development may be required



Required skills:



1. Strong Figma skills

2. Experience designing Shopify stores

3. Experience with Shopify themes such as Dawn, Horizon, Impulse, Prestige, Enterprise, or similar themes

4. Proven ecommerce website design experience, backed by a portfolio

5. Solid understanding of Shopify store structure (sections, blocks, templates, metafields)

6. Excellent mobile-first design ability

7. Good taste in typography, spacing, layout, and visual hierarchy

8. Ability to design practical, buildable layouts

9. Clear written English and strong attention to detail



Nice to have:

1. Basic understanding of Liquid, HTML, CSS, and responsive design

2. Awareness of accessibility basics, such as contrast, hierarchy, and alt text

3. Experience with CRO, product pages, collection filtering, mega menus, bundles, gift guides, or landing pages

4. Experience preparing developer handoff notes

5. Experience using AI tools thoughtfully in the design process



AI usage:



We are an AI-enabled business, and thoughtful AI usage is encouraged.



We are interested in designers who use AI to improve their thinking, speed, research, documentation, creative exploration, and design process. We are not looking for generic AI-generated applications.



How to apply:



Start your reply with the name of an ecommerce store whose design you admire, and one line on why. Then please include the following:



- A link to your portfolio.

- Two ecommerce or Shopify designs you are proud of. Client work, a concept, or a personal project is fine. For each one, briefly explain:



1. what the project was

2. what your role was

3. what design problem you were solving

4. what you would improve if you designed it again today



- Your AI workflow example using this format:



1. Tool used:

2. Task:

3. How AI helped:

4. How you reviewed or improved the output:

5. Final result:



- Choose one product page from any live Shopify store, link it, and briefly explain one thing you think works well and one thing you would improve.

- Your expected hourly or monthly rate, weekly availability, and working hours in your local time zone.



Hiring process:



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short paid design exercise and a 30-minute call, so we can see how you work and you can learn more about us.



Applications that are generic, skip the opening line, do not include ecommerce design examples, or do not answer the application questions will not be prioritized.
