title: IT Product Catalog & Pricing Specialist - Abrahams Consulting LLC  ·  US-based IT Government Contractor (NASA SEWP VI)
description:
This role directly determines our revenue. Abrahams Consulting LLC holds NASA SEWP VI Contract #80TECH26D1658 — a $20 billion federal IT contract. We can only sell what is loaded into our NASA catalog. 



You are the person who builds, maintains, and prices that catalog. Without a well-managed catalog, there are no orders. This is hire #3 on a brand-new government contract team.



This role directly determines our revenue. Abrahams Consulting LLC holds NASA SEWP VI Contract #80TECH26D1658 — a $20 billion federal IT contract. We can only sell what is loaded into our NASA catalog. You are the person who builds, maintains, and prices that catalog. Without a well-managed catalog, there are no orders. This is hire #3 on a brand-new government contract team.



**The scale of this catalog



9

IT technical areas to catalog across



5,000

Max line items per daily submission



500+

Target items loaded within 60 days



The nine technology areas span everything from laptops and servers to software, cloud platforms, networking equipment, AV systems, security tools, and product-based services. Your job is to build this catalog from the ground up and keep it accurate, priced correctly, and growing.



**About the role



You will be responsible for building and maintaining our entire IT product catalog on NASA's SEWP portal. This involves submitting structured data files called Technology Refreshments (TRs) to add, update, and remove products, assigning the correct UN product classification codes (UNSPSC), and ensuring every price we post is at or below our GSA Schedule price. 



You will also track product lifecycle — removing discontinued items before NASA flags them.



This is a data-heavy, process-driven role. You need to be comfortable working with large spreadsheets, following strict formatting rules, and managing hundreds to thousands of product records with precision. A single incorrect price or wrong product code has real consequences on a federal government contract.



Required availability: Monday–Friday, overlap with US Eastern Time business hours — flexible on specific hours but must be reachable during the day for coordination with the PM and DPM.



What you will do



Build the initial product catalog — Load our first 500+ products into the NASA SEWP database within the first 60 days. Work with our Program Manager and supplier contacts to gather product names, descriptions, part numbers, pricing, and UNSPSC codes for each item.



Submit Technology Refreshments (TRs) — Prepare and submit daily TR files in the required keyword-value text format to add new products, update existing ones, change pricing, and remove discontinued items. Follow strict NASA formatting rules — no attachments, no HTML, no logos in TR
s.



Assign UNSPSC codes — Every product in the catalog must have a correct 8-digit United Nations Standard Products and Services Code. You will learn and apply this coding system to accurately classify all IT products and services we offer.



Monitor and maintain price compliance — Our SEWP prices must always be equal to or lower than our GSA Schedule prices. You will check prices regularly, flag any discrepancies, and submit corrections. If a supplier drops their price, you must update our catalog and notify the Contracting Officer within 7 calendar days.



Manage product lifecycle (End of Life) — Track when products are discontinued by manufacturers. Any item on contract for more than 18 months without activity may be flagged by NASA. You will proactively EOL items before that happens.

Manage provider/supplier records — For each manufacturer or supplier we resell, maintain accurate provider records in the SEWP system including supply chain level designations (Authorized Reseller, Subset Reseller, etc.) and supplier point of contact information.



Support quote building — When the PM or DPM builds quotes for federal agencies, you will be the reference point for accurate product details, current pricing, and CLIN numbers. Help verify that every item quoted is active in the SEWP catalog.

Maintain catalog accuracy reports — Keep internal spreadsheets tracking what is in the catalog, what needs updating, what is coming up for EOL, and what new products are pending submission.

Why this role is different

-Supporting a NASA contract

-Your work sits at the heart of a $20 billion federal IT procurement vehicle.



-Long-term stability

 response

title: AI Video Editor – Product Texture & Design Swaps (Kling 3.0 / Runway Gen-3)
description:
Job Description:We are looking for a highly advanced AI Video Editor for immediate, long-term work. If your idea of AI editing is just typing a text prompt into Higgsfield or Seedance and hoping for the best, do not apply. 



We need an expert who understands advanced structure-guided video-to-video editing and motion control. 



 The workflow is straightforward but requires absolute perfection: We will provide you with 5–10 second TikTok clips of a product, along with a flat image of a new design. 



Your job is to swap the pattern/texture on specific parts of the product (e.g., fabric or features) using professional image-to-video or video-to-video workflows.  



The final output MUST look 100% realistic. 



The background, text, and people in the video cannot glitch, warp, or change in any way, shape, or form.  



### Required Skillset & Tools:  

Kling AI 3.0 (Motion Control / Reference-to-Video Mode): You know how to modify a keyframe in Photoshop/Midjourney and feed it back into Kling to map the new texture over the original motion flawlessly.  



Runway Gen-3 Alpha (Video-to-Video & Multi-Motion Brush): You are an expert at masking out specific areas of a product and swapping textures without affecting the rest of the frame.  Flawless Consistency: You must know how to maintain strict structural integrity so that faces, backgrounds, and hands do not alter.  



### Speed, Quality, & Communication:



These are our three non-negotiables:

Speed: Everything is ready to go. You must be able to test and render clips quickly.

Quality: Zero AI "hallucinations," zero blurring, and perfect edge mapping.  

Communication: Highly responsive and reliable.?? CRITICAL WARNING: If you lack speed, attention to detail, or professional communication, please do not waste your time or ours by applying. We have a massive volume of daily work and zero tolerance for sloppy, glitchy renders.



### The Hiring Process (Start ASAP):Everything is ready to go right now. If your application stands out, we will immediately send you one short 3–5 second test clip and a design pattern.If your test clip looks completely realistic and is delivered quickly, you will immediately be added to a full Google Drive with daily volume and started on a long-term contract.



### How to Apply:Reply to this post with:A link to your portfolio showing advanced product manipulation or structured Video-to-Video AI work.  Explicitly state which advanced AI video tools you currently have paid subscriptions to (e.g., Runway, Kling, etc.).Type the words "AI STRUCTURE" at the very top of your application so we know you read this entire post.

title: Short-Form + Long-Form Video Editor (Daily Driver, Fluent English Required)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

I run a US-based wholesale and e-commerce business and I am building a content channel around it. I am launching a daily short-form video presence (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) plus a long-form YouTube channel. I need one editor who can own both.

This is a long-term role. I am not looking for a one-off project. I want someone I can work with for years as the channel grows.

You will be editing real footage of me and my actual business operations. The content is authentic and operator-driven, not generic talking-head fluff, so I need an editor who understands pacing, hooks, and retention, not just someone who can make cuts.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will edit one short-form video per day on most days (this is the core of the role). You will also edit longer YouTube videos (8 to 20 minutes) on a weekly or biweekly basis. You will add captions, sound design, b-roll, and on-screen text. You will send me short notes on what is and is not working in my footage so my filming improves over time. You will manage your own file organization and hit consistent deadlines without me chasing you.

WHAT I REQUIRE

Fluent, natural written and spoken English. This is non-negotiable. You will be reading scripts, understanding US humor and references, and giving me feedback in English. If your English is not strong, this role is not for you.

Proven short-form editing experience with view counts or case studies you can show me. I want to see videos you edited that performed, not just a generic reel.

Long-form YouTube editing experience, including structuring for retention.

Comfort with fast daily turnaround on short-form.

The ability to give creative feedback, not just execute. If I hand you weak footage, I want you to tell me why it is weak and how to fix it next time.

NICE TO HAVE

Experience editing for personal brands or founders. Familiarity with US business or e-commerce content. Basic motion graphics or animated captions.

HOW TO APPLY

Read this carefully, because I will ignore any application that does not follow it.

Send links to two short-form videos and one long-form video you personally edited. Tell me what you did on each and how it performed.

- Hands-on with auditing tools: experience with SE Ranking and Local Falcon is a strong plus; if you haven't used them but have used comparable tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, BrightLocal, Screaming Frog, etc.), show us you can ramp fast.

- Analytical thinking: you can look at a set of results and explain what it means and what to do about it, not just report the figures.

s to clients

- Comfort building reports to communicate trends.





Tools You'll Use

How To Apply

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
About This Role

I run a high-volume TikTok Shop affiliate content operation across two accounts. I film the content — you edit it and make it convert. I need a detail-oriented editor who understands short-form video structure, can follow a repeatable framework, and delivers clean, scroll-stopping videos on time, every time.



This is not a creative role — it is a precision execution role. I have a proven framework. Your job is to apply it perfectly and consistently at scale.



What You'll Do

Core Editing Tasks

• Cut raw footage (1–2 min clips) down to polished 25–45 second TikTok Shop videos

• Follow a provided script and visual notes for every video — structure, cuts, and text are all specified for you

• Add on-screen text overlays manually in CapCut — overlays and auto-captions must NEVER say the same thing simultaneously

• Apply auto-captions for the verbal track; all other text added as separate overlays in CapCut

• Cut and sync on-camera audio or VO cleanly to visual beats

• Maintain consistent pacing per the script notes: hook energy at the top, energy drop at the CTA

• Export files in correct format and resolution for TikTok upload



Workflow & Volume

• Raw footage is filmed in batch sessions and delivered via Google Drive

• Each batch covers approximately 5 products — expect multiple videos per product per batch

• Every video comes with a script and visual direction notes — you are not guessing what to do

• Target volume: up to 10 edited videos per day, delivered same week as footage is received

• Exact due dates are set per batch based on volume — you will always know your deadline before starting

• Deliver completed files back to the shared folder, organized by product

• Flag missing footage, unclear notes, or any issues before starting — not after

• Track completed videos in a shared log



What I'm Looking For

Required

• Proficient in CapCut — you must be fast and accurate, not learning as you go

• Strong understanding of short-form video pacing and cuts

• Able to follow written visual direction exactly — no improvising structure

• Detail-oriented — text/caption rules, energy shifts, and timing matter

• Reliable communicator — responds within 24 hours, flags issues proactively

• Can handle high volume with consistency — same quality on video 1 and video 21

• Comfortable with repetitive framework — this is not a creative exploration role

• Access to a computer capable of running CapCut at volume

• Stable internet connection for file transfer



Nice to Have

• Experience editing TikTok or Reels content for product/affiliate/UGC accounts

• Familiarity with TikTok Shop content style

• Basic color correction and audio cleanup

• Experience working with US-based content creators remotely



This Is NOT the Right Role If...

• You want creative freedom to redesign the structure or add your own style

• You cannot handle high-volume, repetitive editing

• You need heavy direction on every edit — the scripts and visual notes are your guide

• You are not responsive or proactive in communication

• You've never used CapCut before



How to Apply

To be considered, your application must include ALL of the following:



• 1. A short intro: who you are, where you're based, and how long you've been editing

• 2. Your CapCut experience level (beginner / intermediate / advanced) and how long you've used it

• 3. 2–3 examples of short-form video you've edited (TikTok, Reels, or Shorts — links or files)

• 4. Your current availability and how many videos per week you can handle

• 5. Your rate (per video or per hour — state which)

• 6. One sentence describing what you think makes a TikTok hook work



Applications missing any of the above will not be reviewed.

title: Walmart Marketplace Specialist — Bulk Catalog Listing and Management
description:

Manage and clean large catalog spreadsheets — mapping our product data into Walmart's required fields, fixing errors, and resolving feed/processing failures at scale.

Proven track record bulk-uploading products via Walmart's spreadsheet templates (Full Item Spec / bulk item upload). You should be comfortable with large files, not 10-item uploads.

Direct experience requesting and obtaining a Walmart GTIN/UPC exemption, including handling a denial and successfully reapplying.

Strong spreadsheet skills (Excel / Google Sheets): VLOOKUP, data cleanup, formatting large datasets, splitting variants, batch edits.

title: YouTube Storytelling Specialist & Product Shorts Video Editor
description:
YouTube Storytelling Specialist & Product Shorts Video Editor



We are looking for a part-time YouTube Storytelling Specialist and Product Shorts Video Editor to help create short-form product videos and longer story-driven YouTube content for a growing headwear and apparel brand.



This role is for someone who can do more than basic video editing. We need someone who understands storytelling, pacing, hooks, product presentation, YouTube structure, short-form content, and how to turn raw footage into engaging content.



The main focus will be:



1. Product shorts videos for hats, apparel, product drops, behind-the-scenes clips, and ecommerce promotion.

2. YouTube storytelling content that documents the daily journey of building a brand from the ground up.



Main Responsibilities



You will help create:

* Product shorts videos

* YouTube Shorts

* Instagram Reels

* TikTok-style product videos

* Short product launch videos

* Behind-the-scenes business clips

* Packaging and order fulfillment videos

* Daily brand-building journey edits

* Longer YouTube storytelling videos

* Founder/business journey content

* Video hooks and captions

* YouTube title ideas

* Thumbnail concepts

* Repurposed clips from longer videos



Product Shorts Video Focus



We need someone who can take raw product clips, product photos, packaging clips, behind-the-scenes footage, and simple product ideas and turn them into clean, engaging short-form videos.



These videos may be used for:



* New product drops

* Hat and apparel promotion

* Etsy or Shopify product marketing

* YouTube Shorts

* Instagram Reels

* TikTok

*
 short-form content

* Brand awareness



You should understand how to create a strong hook in the first few seconds, keep pacing tight, use clean captions, choose good music, and make the product look desirable.



YouTube Storytelling Focus



We also want to document the journey of building the brand. This may include raw footage of:



* Designing products

* Making hats

* Packaging orders

* Preparing for launches

* Building the Shopify site

* Behind-the-scenes business decisions

* Wins and failures

* Daily progress

* Customer reactions

* Events, pop-ups, or in-person selling

* The real process of growing a brand



Your job will be to help turn that raw footage into watchable, story-driven YouTube content.

We want the content to feel real, honest, and engaging — not fake, overly polished, or overly corporate.



Brief Workflow



We will provide raw video clips, product footage, product photos, brand direction, notes, and rough content ideas.

Your job will be to organize the footage, find the story, edit the video, add captions or text when needed, choose music, improve pacing, and create a finished video that fits the platform.



Some projects may be quick product shorts. Other projects may be longer YouTube edits about the process of building the brand.



We need someone who can follow direction but also bring creative judgment and storytelling ideas.



Content Style We Like



Our preferred video style is:



* Clean

* Real

* Modern

* Engaging

* Product-focused when needed

* Story-driven when needed

* Natural but polished

* Strong opening hook

* Good pacing

* Clear captions

* Not overly cheesy

* Not overly cluttered

* Not overly corporate



For the YouTube storytelling content, we want viewers to feel like they are watching the journey unfold.



Skills We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate should understand:



* YouTube storytelling

* Short-form product video editing

* YouTube Shorts

* Instagram Reels

* TikTok-style editing

* Long-form YouTube editing

* Hook-based editing

* Captions and subtitles

* B-roll selection

* Music and sound effects

* Product video pacing

* Thumbnail concepts

* YouTube title ideas

* Basic YouTube SEO

* Repurposing long videos into short clips

* Organizing raw footage and project folders



Helpful Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Editing for YouTube channels

* Editing founder journey or business journey content

* Editing ecommerce product videos

* Editing apparel, hat, streetwear, lifestyle, or brand content

* Creating YouTube Shorts, Reels, or TikToks

* Creating thumbnail concepts

* Turning rough footage into a clear story

* Repurposing one video into multiple pieces of content



Tools



You may use tools such as:



* CapCut

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Final Cut Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Canva

* Photoshop

* YouTube Studio

* Descript

* OpusClip

* Google Drive

* Dropbox

* ChatGPT or AI tools



We care more about the final result than the exact software.



This role is focused on YouTube storytelling, product shorts videos, video editing, content packaging, and brand documentation.



Hours & Schedule



This is a flexible part-time role to start.

Hours are flexible and negotiable depending on skill level, availability, communication, and quality of work.

Reliability, communication, and completing projects on time are more important than a fixed schedule.

title: E-Commerce Customer Support Representative (WMS / Order Issues)
description:
We are a Miami-based 3PL company that ships thousands of e-commerce orders every day for a growing portfolio of online brands. We are looking for an experienced Customer Service Virtual Assistant to help our clients’ support teams resolve shipping-related issues quickly, accurately, and professionally.



This is a new role at our company. You would be our first dedicated CS VA, so we are looking for someone who is comfortable working independently, adapting as processes improve, and sharing practical ideas for making the workflow better.



You will not communicate directly with consumers. Instead, you will work with the customer service teams at the brands we fulfill for. When they need help with a shipping or order issue, you will investigate the situation in our warehouse system, coordinate with our internal team, and provide a clear resolution or next step.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your day-to-day work may include:



Investigating delayed, missing, damaged, returned, or incorrectly shipped orders

Checking order history, shipment status, tracking information, inventory activity, and warehouse notes

Reviewing issues such as wrong items sent, address changes, duplicate orders, lost packages, and fulfillment delays

Using our warehouse management system, Warehance, to research and update order-related information

Communicating with our warehouse team through Slack and Telegram when an issue requires action on the floor

Providing clear, professional updates to client brand support teams.



Following each issue through until it is resolved, escalated, or handed off with complete notes

Identifying recurring problems and flagging patterns that may affect multiple orders or clients

Helping us build better support processes, templates, and tracking systems as the role develops

What Success Looks Like



You are likely a strong fit if you can:



Read a ticket, identify the real issue, and know what information to check first

Work carefully inside a WMS without making unnecessary changes to orders

Keep communication concise, accurate, and easy for others to act on

Stay organized while handling multiple tickets and follow-ups

Know when an issue can be resolved independently and when it needs to be escalated

Take ownership of a problem instead of simply passing it along

Required Experience



Please apply only if you have experience with at least some of the following:



E-commerce customer service, logistics support, fulfillment support, or order management

A warehouse management system or shipping platform such as Warehance, ShipStation, Shopify, ShipHero, Extensiv, NetSuite, or a similar tool

Investigating shipment tracking, fulfillment errors, address corrections, returns, or inventory-related order issues

Communicating with internal teams through Slack, Telegram, email, or ticketing systems

Writing clear English updates for clients, teammates, or support teams



You will need reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and the ability to work independently without constant supervision.



Pay and Schedule

Pay: $6.00 per hour

Schedule: Monday through Friday, with availability needed between 7:00 AM and 3:00 PM Eastern Time

Work style: This is a ticket-driven role. Some periods will be busy and others may be quiet. You will be expected to respond to assigned tickets during your agreed coverage hours, but this is not guaranteed to be a full eight-hour day every day.

How to Apply:



Start your application with the word READYTOSHIP.



Then answer the questions below in your own words. We are looking for direct, specific answers based on your actual experience:



What e-commerce, fulfillment, logistics, or customer support experience do you have?

Which warehouse, order-management, shipping, or ticketing systems have you used? Please name the systems and explain what you did in them.

Tell us about one difficult shipping or order issue you personally handled. What was the problem, what steps did you take to investigate it, and what was the final outcome?

Imagine a brand says a customer’s package shows “delivered,” but the customer says they never received it. What are the first three things you would check before responding?

What hours are you available to work between 7:00 AM and 3:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday?

What is one detail from this job post that stands out to you, and why?



Applications with specific examples, clear steps, and real system experience will receive priority review.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Head of Support - SaaS Company
description:
About Disputely



Disputely is a fintech building the refund and dispute resolution platform for D2C brands, subscription companies, and the payments ecosystem. We help merchants prevent and recover chargebacks.



The Role



You'll own the entire support experience for our merchants, from the 
nt they sign up to the day-to-day questions that keep them successful. You'll handle
 and live chat support, run onboarding and offboarding, and build the playbooks, docs, and training that let us scale support without dropping quality. Over time you'll grow into the leader of our support function, hiring and training the agents who report to you.



This is high-leverage, high-trust work. You'll learn fintech and customer success from the inside, have direct mentorship from the founder, and own the systems that keep our merchants happy and retained as the company grows.



What You'll Own (Responsibilities)



1. Onboard and offboard clients

Own the full client lifecycle. Walk new merchants through setup, get them to their first win fast, and make offboarding clean and professional. First impressions and last impressions both matter.



2. Run
 support

Be the front line for merchant questions over
. Respond fast, solve the actual problem, and keep a friendly, clear voice. No ticket falls through the cracks.



3. Run live chat support

Handle real-time chat with merchants during support hours. Resolve issues on the spot where you can, escalate cleanly where you can't.



4. Drive client retention

Spot the early signs a merchant is struggling or going quiet, and act before they churn. Turn support conversations into reasons for clients to stay.



5. Build training and documentation

Write the help docs, internal playbooks, canned responses, and onboarding guides. As we add support agents below you, you'll train them and hold the quality bar.



Who We're Looking For



Required

- Experience in e-commerce and customer support (you've supported real customers for a D2C, SaaS, fintech, or e-commerce company)

- Fluent English, written and spoken, you'll be the voice merchants hear every day

- Strong organizational skills, you love clean queues, clear processes, and well-documented answers

- Comfortable owning both
 and live chat support

- Self-directed, you can run support end-to-end without being told every step

- Fast learner, comfortable picking up new tools quickly (helpdesk software, chat tools, Notion, Loom)

- Coachable, you take feedback well, want to grow, and aren't precious about your work



Nice to Have

- Background in payments, e-commerce, D2C, SaaS, or fintech

- Experience writing help docs, knowledge bases, or support training material

- Experience with helpdesk and live chat tools (Intercom, Zendesk, Gorgias, Crisp, or similar)

- Experience onboarding new customers or running a customer success motion

- Experience at a startup under 50 people (you know how to wear multiple hats)



We're NOT looking for

- Someone who only wants to answer tickets and clock out (this role is about owning the whole support experience, not just closing the queue)

- A salesperson (this is support and retention, not outbound)

- Someone who needs hand-holding through every task



Support response time and resolution quality

  - Customer satisfaction scores

  - Quality of documentation and agent training

- 100% remote, work from anywhere (some overlap with US Eastern time required)

- Direct mentorship from the founder, you'll learn fintech, support, and operations from someone in the room

- Path to grow as the support team grows below you, first promotion target: Head of Support / Customer Success Lead as we add agents under you

- Real ownership of the systems that keep merchants happy for years

- No bureaucracy, small team, fast decisions, ship fast



Disputely is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire for talent, drive, and fit, not for pedigree.

This role sits at the centre of MEDirect's AI-first build. You will work alongside Natalia, our Senior Product & Delivery Manager in Australia, who holds the structure for our product delivery.

Your job is to own the discipline of delivery: the artefacts, the cadence, the follow-up, the documentation, so that the broader product and engineering team can spend their time on the judgement calls. You will own Jira and Confluence end-to-end. You will write the Business Requirements Documents. You will translate decisions into tickets engineering can pick up without re-clarification.

This is a coordination and business analysis role, with room to grow. It is not a Scrum Master role. It is not an engineering role. It is the operating discipline that makes an AI-first scale-up actually ship.

3. Key responsibilities

3.1 Delivery coordination

• Track activities, milestones, dependencies, risks and action items across multiple concurrent MEDirect 2.0 workstreams.

• Follow up with engineers, designers, product owners and business stakeholders to ensure actions and deliverables land on time.

• Maintain weekly project status. Surface blockers early. Escalate to Natalia before delays compound.

3.2 Business analysis and documentation

• Prepare and maintain Business Requirements Documents, feature briefs, process maps, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Capture requirements, decisions and actions from workshops and stakeholder sessions.

• Document business processes, workflows and user journeys as the team moves to MEDirect 2.0.

• Keep project documentation current and discoverable. Nothing important should be lost between meetings.

3.3 Jira and Confluence ownership

• Own Jira backlog structure, ticket quality, epic hierarchy and project board health.

• Create, update and refine epics, stories, tasks and acceptance criteria.

• Support sprint preparation, backlog refinement and release planning.

• Maintain Confluence spaces, project documentation, meeting notes and the team knowledge base.

3.4 Product and engineering support

• Translate approved requirements into clear, structured tickets that engineering can pick up without re-clarification.

• Support User Acceptance Testing preparation, defect tracking and release readiness.

• Coordinate handovers between business, product, design and engineering.

• Make sure requirements, designs and supporting materials are ready before development starts.

3.5 Reporting and governance

• Prepare project status reports, delivery summaries and progress updates for Natalia and the founders.

• Track key delivery metrics and milestones.

• Support meeting preparation, agenda creation and stakeholder communications.

3.6 AI fluency

• Use approved AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar) every day for documentation, summarisation, ticket drafting, meeting notes and follow-up.

• Document AI-assisted workflows so the rest of the team can adopt them.

• Surface new AI use cases that would lift delivery productivity to Natalia and the AI Council.

4. Required experience and capabilities

This is a mid-level role with a senior bar on quality. We are looking for someone with the discipline of a seasoned operator and the curiosity of a builder.

• Exceptional written and spoken English. Non-negotiable. You write business documents the Australian team can publish without rework, and you hold your own on calls with senior stakeholders. Tested at the interview through a written task and a video screen.

• 3 to 5 years in delivery coordination, business analysis, project coordination or product operations in a software or technology business.

• Strong Jira and Confluence experience. You have lived in these tools, not just touched them. Backlog structure, ticket hygiene, sprint cadence.

• Demonstrated business analysis skills. You can run a requirements workshop, write a BRD, build a process map, and trace a user journey end to end.

• Strong written communication. Your documentation is clear, current, and structured.

• Real curiosity about AI tools. You are already using Claude, ChatGPT or similar in your day-to-day work. Not as a novelty.

• Comfortable with pace and ambiguity. MEDirect 2.0 is being built. The brief will move. You will roll with it.

• Confident with senior stakeholders. You can hold your own with engineers, designers, product people, and the Australian founders.

5. Nice to have

• Experience working with Australian, US or other Western teams (not just BPO setups).

• Exposure to software delivery in an Agile environment.

• Experience supporting UAT and testing activities.

• Familiarity with healthcare, legal, insurance or another regulated industry.

• Direct experience working alongside product, engineering or UX teams.

• Certifications welcome (CBAP, PMI-PBA, CSPO) but not required.

6. How this role works with others

Internal partners

• Natalia Nishenia — Senior Product & Delivery Manager — your manager, daily.

• Andrew Waugh — Technical Director — for engineering coordination.

• Sue Larsen and Ross Baker — Co-founders — for milestone reporting and escalation.

• Engineering, product and design teams — daily collaboration on workstreams

title: IP, Copyright, Trademark & Public Domain Research Specialist
description:
We are an asset-light IP holding and brand licensing platform modeled on enterprise brand managers like Authentic Brands Group and Disney. We acquire, transform, and protect high-equity trademarks and public domain assets, licensing them out to best-in-class operators while retaining 100% ownership of the core IP. We operate entirely in text, code, and legal frameworks—we own the asset, the licensee owns the overhead.



The Role

We are seeking a brilliant, highly meticulous IP, Copyright & Public Domain Research Specialist to act as the internal human layer for our forensic asset research. In this role, you will be 100% focused on legal data, clearance, and asset tracking. You will utilize Google Gemini alongside official databases to clear trademarks, register copyrights, map out the entry of legacy works into the public domain, and build institutional background dossiers on distressed brands targeted for acquisition.



Daily Responsibilities

US Copyright Execution: Prepare and systematically file official US copyright applications for all original Ventured materials, layout structures, and transformed derivative works.



USPTO Forensic Research: Actively monitor the USPTO database to isolate dead, cancelled, or lapsed zombie brands (specifically tracking Section 8/9 renewal failures) matching our target lifestyle and consumer criteria.



Acquisition Fact-Checking & Dossier Building: Conduct exhaustive background research on potential brand acquisitions, compiling comprehensive dossiers for executive review that break down financial health, past operational scale, corporate history, and brand narratives.



Public Domain Timeline Mapping: Audit and project the exact years legacy creative works, literature, characters, and assets will enter the public domain under US law, flagging high-commercial-value opportunities for our revival pipeline.

Data & Vault Organization: Maintain pristine, hyper-organized tracking systems within Google Docs and Google Sheets, documenting all active filings, renewal timelines, and pre-vetted brand data.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Deliver 3 completely cleared, pre-vetted zombie brand or public domain dossiers per week.

Maintain zero backlog on original copyright registrations for internal corporate materials.

Keep the master public domain entry calendar updated with 100% chronological accuracy.

Requirements



Deep, verified understanding of US trademark law, copyright law, and public domain mechanics (e.g., the 95-year rule for published works).



Advanced proficiency in prompting and collaborating with Google Gemini to accelerate deep research and text compilation.

Expert-level mastery of Google Docs and Google Sheets for data architecture and reporting.

Absolute forensic precision—you spot the hidden litigation risk or registration defect that everyone else misses.

title: Strategic Business Development Lead (Medical Sector)
description:
We are a boutique agency building high-leverage assets for medical practices. We are not looking for a telemarketer to read a script. We are looking for a Detective and a Hunter.



Your goal is to penetrate the "Gatekeepers" at medical centers, reach the decision-makers, and perform deep discovery to understand exactly where their practice is bleeding revenue—and then match them with our solution.



- - - What You Will Do (The 3 Phases)



1. The Research (The Sniper Approach)



You will not blindly dial numbers. You will research local clinics, identify the exact decision-maker (Owner/Lead Doctor/Office Manager), and find the angle before you pick up the phone.



2. The Outreach (The Hunt)



Cold Calling & Cold
ing. You must be comfortable with high volume, but focused on quality conversations.



The Feedback Loop (Crucial): You are expected to A/B test your own approach. If a script isn't working, you change it. You do not wait for instructions. You analyze your own call recordings: "Why did I lose them at minute 2?" and fix it for the next call.



3. The Needs Analysis (The Match)



You are not "selling" immediately. You are "diagnosing."



You will ask probing questions to uncover their pain (e.g., "How much time is your front desk spending on non-medical questions?").



Once the pain is exposed, you match their specific problem to our specific service package.





- - - Who You Are (The DNA):



You Are Fearless: You can call a busy Surgeon's office and hold your ground with the receptionist.



You Are a Chameleon: You can match the tone of a stressed Office Manager or an arrogant Doctor instantly.



You Are Low-Maintenance: You do not need daily pep talks. You set your own targets. You report on results, not effort.



You Are Empathetic: You don't just talk; you listen. You can hear the stress in a prospect's voice and pivot the conversation to help them.



- - - Requirements:



Proven track record in B2B Cold Calling (bonus if in Medical/SaaS).



Ability to self-audit: You must provide a weekly report of "What worked, what failed, and what I’m changing next week."

title: Amazon PPC Growth Lead
description:
Amazon PPC Growth Lead



Please fill out this Google Form to apply for this job:





Availability

Full-time Only: Do not apply if you are seeking part-time work.

Required Hours: 8:00am to 5:00pm CST, Monday through Friday.

100% Remote: No travel required.

Internet: Reliable connection is a must.



About the Role

We are hiring an Amazon PPC Growth Lead to own advertising strategy and performance across a portfolio of Amazon brands.

This is not a maintenance role.

We are not looking for someone who simply adjusts bids, checks budgets, and waits for instructions. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of PPC as a growth function inside the business.

If you are used to brand managers specifically telling you which products to raise budgets on and by how much, this is not the role for you.

You will analyze the performance, know the brands inside and out, talk to the clients directly, collaborate with the brand manager on joint strategy, and advise on the strategy necessary to drive the growth.

The right person knows how to analyze performance, identify what matters, create a plan, and communicate clearly with clients. They understand that Amazon advertising is not just about ACoS. It is about revenue, profitability, ranking, product growth, budget allocation, conversion, and total business performance.

You should be the person who sees what is happening before the client asks. You bring ideas. You find problems. You recommend action. You follow through.

Clients should feel confident that you understand their business and are actively leading the advertising strategy forward.

You must be comfortable organizing and presenting data and analysis to the client, explaining your analysis and decision making and talking for a 1 hour PPC meeting 4-5 times per week.

We are building a growth oriented agency with the longer term goal of launching our own products.



What You’ll Own

You will own PPC strategy and performance for assigned Amazon accounts.

That means you will:

Build and manage Amazon PPC strategies that support client growth goals

Analyze performance across campaigns, products, keywords, search terms, budgets, and profitability

Identify opportunities to grow revenue, improve efficiency, reduce waste, and scale what is working

Explain what is happening in the account, why it is happening, and what should happen next

Bring proactive recommendations to clients and internal teams

Create action plans for underperforming areas and follow through until there is a result

Connect PPC performance to broader business drivers like conversion rate, pricing, inventory, reviews, organic rank, margin, and product lifecycle

Communicate strategy clearly so clients trust that their business is being actively managed

Stay current on Amazon Ads changes, new opportunities, testing strategies, and competitive shifts



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured by whether you “touched” campaigns or adjusted bids.

Success is measured by whether you are helping move the client’s business forward.

You are successful when:

Clients feel confident that PPC is being owned, not maintained

You bring smart recommendations before being asked

You can clearly explain performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps

Accounts become stronger, cleaner, more strategic, and more scalable under your ownership

PPC decisions are tied to business outcomes, not just campaign metrics

You identify problems early and come with solutions

You know when to push for growth, when to protect profitability, and when to challenge the current strategy

Your work creates visible impact on revenue, profitability, efficiency, or client confidence



What We Do Not Want

This role is not a fit for someone who:

Is used to spending most of your time raising and lowering bids

Waits to be told what to do

Runs mostly auto and category campaigns

Reports high level aggregated numbers without diving into the details and explaining what they mean

Thinks ACoS is the only metric that matters

Avoids accountability for business outcomes

Needs someone else to create the strategy

Does the minimum required campaign work and calls it optimization

Uses AI or Automation to do the majority of the work.

We need someone who thinks, owns, communicates, and drives.



Responsibilities

Own Amazon PPC strategy across assigned client accounts

Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns

Analyze account performance and identify growth, efficiency, and profitability opportunities

Build campaign structures that support scale, control, and clear decision-making

Manage keyword strategy, search term harvesting, negatives, placements, budgets, and bid strategy

Develop testing plans for new campaigns, products, keywords, placements, creative, and budget strategies

Review performance trends and create clear action plans

Prepare client-facing insights, recommendations, and strategic updates

Partner with account managers and leadership to align PPC strategy with client business goals

Identify when non-PPC issues are impacting performance, including pricing, inventory, reviews, conversion rate, content, or competition

Communicate risks and opportunities early, with recommended next steps

Must be highly competent managing accounts with over $100k/mo advertising budgets.



Goals for This Role

The goal of this role is simple:

Make clients trust that their Amazon advertising is being actively led by someone who understands the business.

You will be expected to:

Drive profitable growth where opportunity exists

Improve inefficient or underperforming accounts

Build client trust through clear strategic communication

Create proactive recommendations that lead to action

Make PPC strategy easier for clients and internal teams to understand

Turn data into decisions

Own outcomes, not just tasks



Requirements

3+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience

Must be able to run accounts manually.

Must also be familiar with Pacvue

Strong understanding of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display

Deep knowledge of ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CVR, CPC, CTR, keyword strategy, campaign structure, and profitability

Ability to analyze data and turn it into clear recommendations

Strong communication skills, especially when explaining performance and strategy

Experience managing multiple Amazon accounts or brands

Ability to work independently and take ownership without constant direction

Strong judgment around growth, efficiency, budget allocation, and profitability tradeoffs



Preferred Experience

Experience working in an agency or multi-client environment

Experience with Amazon reporting tools, PPC software, or business intelligence dashboards

Experience presenting strategy directly to clients or senior stakeholders

Understanding of Amazon SEO, product launches, ranking strategy, promotions, and catalog performance



Who Will Thrive Here

You will thrive in this role if you are used to driving a business forward with ad strategies. You are analytical, creative, and accountable.

You like digging into accounts and figuring out what is really going on. You are not satisfied with surface-level reporting. You want to know what is working, what is broken, where the opportunity is, and what should happen next.

You do not need to be micromanaged. You want ownership. You want to be trusted. You want your recommendations to matter.

Most importantly, you understand that great PPC management is not maintenance.

It is leadership.

title: Shopify Designer — Direct-Response PDP + Homepage (Women's Health DTC Brand)
description:
We're Uvelle — a new direct-to-consumer supplement brand in women's urinary health (a cranberry + D-mannose formula for women with recurring UTIs). We're launching on paid direct-response traffic, so the website isn't a brochure — it's the close.



You'll design from a finished brand guideline (colors, typography, voice, and core components are already defined), so you're working inside a clear system, not staring at a blank canvas.



What you'll build





A high-converting product page (PDP) — the centerpiece. A long-form, direct-response PDP engineered to convert cold and warm paid traffic. Not a default theme product page.

A homepage that makes a brand-new brand feel established and trustworthy, and routes traffic to the right place.

(Bonus) supporting graphics — see bonus section.





The PDP must include these DR sections



We know what a converting page looks like. We expect you to design (and ideally improve on) sections like:





Hero with clear value prop, star rating, primary CTA, and trust badges

Sticky add-to-cart bar

Benefit bullets / "what makes it different"

Problem agitation (the pain we solve)

How it works / mechanism + ingredient breakdown with dosages

Reviews, testimonials, and UGC-style social proof

Comparison chart (vs. the old way / vs. alternatives)

Bundle + subscription pricing with clear anchoring and a "most popular" tier

Money-back guarantee / risk reversal

Founder or "why we made this" story block

FAQ that handles objections

Trust strip (clinical dosing, made-in-USA, secure checkout, etc.)





The homepage must





Build instant credibility for a brand with no history yet

Lead with the core promise and social proof

Funnel visitors cleanly toward the PDP / offer

Feel premium and trustworthy — not like a generic Shopify template





You're a strong fit if you





Have built multiple Shopify DTC stores, not just edited themes

Think in conversion terms — hierarchy, friction, objection-handling, mobile-first

Are fluent in a page builder (Replo, GemPages, Shogun) and/or custom Liquid

Have a sharp eye for clean, premium, on-brand design

Communicate clearly and hit deadlines





Proof required — non-negotiable



This is the part we care about most. We need to see real work, not promises.





Links to at least 2–3 LIVE Shopify product pages you designed/built — ideally supplement, health, beauty, or DTC.

Bonus points

 design, packaging, or Amazon A+ content. If you can design the page and the creative, you move to the top of the pile.

Tools / stack

To show us you actually read this, please include all of the following:

title: Full Charge Bookkeeper - US Transportation Company
description:
Higher Ground Transportation Services, Inc.  ·  
  ·  Remote / Virtual  ·  Full-Time Salary



About You ----------------



You're the kind of person who genuinely enjoys making a business's finances make sense. The messy QuickBooks file, the pile of unreconciled accounts, the invoices going out late — these aren't just problems to you, they're puzzles worth solving. You've worked with US small businesses before, you know how to talk to clients and subcontractors without hand-holding, and you take quiet pride in the fact that your books are clean, your reports land on time, and your principals never have to wonder what's happening with the money.



If you're looking for a role where you own the financial system — not just maintain it — and where your attention to detail and follow-through directly shapes whether a growing transportation company hits its numbers, this is it.





About Higher Ground Transportation Services ----------------



Higher Ground Transportation Services is a Baltimore-based transportation company that moves students, construction crews, and other clients reliably, every day. Founded and led by CEO Jan, with COO Teressa running operations, Higher Ground has earned contracts with Baltimore City Public Schools, Clark Construction, DPR, and a growing roster of partners. The company is at an inflection point — scaling up, bringing financial operations in-house, and building the systems that will support its next phase of growth. The person who steps into this role will have a direct line to leadership and a real stake in getting the financial foundation right.





About the Role ----------------



This is a full-time, fully remote bookkeeping and financial operations role reporting directly to Jan (CEO). You'll own the company's books in QuickBooks, manage AR and AP, handle high-volume invoicing across multiple contract types, coordinate subcontractor billing, and produce the monthly financial statements that give Jan and Teressa the visibility they need to run the business. You'll also serve as the primary point of contact for client billing questions and work closely with Jan's Virtual Assistant to keep the quote-to-booking pipeline moving.



This is a build role. You'll inherit a QuickBooks file that needs cleanup, processes that need documentation, and a financial operation that needs ownership. If you like starting with a blank slate and making it better, this is the right opportunity.





What You'll Do ----------------



Core bookkeeping and financial operations:

 • Own the QuickBooks file — clean it up, keep it current, and make it the reliable source of truth for the business

 • Reconcile all bank, credit card, and loan accounts monthly

 • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable end-to-end

 • Produce monthly financial statements: P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, AR aging, AP aging

 • Support year-end preparation and CPA coordination



Invoicing and contract billing:

 • Handle all customer invoicing — accurately, on time, and on cadence — for schools, construction clients, summer camps, and subcontractor trips

 • Populate client-specific invoice templates with zero-error accuracy (dates, trip data, PO numbers)

 • Manage invoicing volume during peak periods (500+ trips over an 8-week summer camp season)



Subcontractor and DPR contract management:

 • Collect, review, and verify subcontractor invoices against actual work performed

 • Communicate with subcontractors regarding missing information, corrections, payment status, and deadlines

 • Manage dedicated invoicing for the DPR contract and farmed-in trips



Client communication and revenue operations:

 • Follow up on unpaid invoices and lapsed quotes — professionally and persistently

 • Confirm quote acceptance, payment method, and PO requirements before trips are finalized

 • Work with Jan's VA to keep the Working Document current: quote status, payment method, PO requirements, invoice status, trip readiness





A Day in the Life ----------------



You start the morning by reviewing the QuickBooks dashboard and flagging anything that needs same-day attention — an overdue invoice, a subcontractor payment due this week, a reconciliation discrepancy from yesterday. You send the daily status note to Jan before 9am without being asked.



Mid-morning, you pull the BCPS invoices for the previous week's trips, populate the mileage and time formulas in the client template, and transmit them on schedule. You follow up by phone with a construction client whose invoice from three weeks ago is still outstanding — you've
ed twice; this one needs a call.



After lunch, you reconcile the last of the credit card accounts for month-end, generate the AR aging report, and flag one account that's gone 60 days past due for Jan's review. You finish the day by entering three new subcontractor invoices, verifying them against the trip log, and updating the Working Document so the VA has current status on tomorrow's pending bookings.

Nothing dropped. The books moved. Leadership has what they need.





What We're Looking For ----------------



Must have:

 • Strong QuickBooks proficiency — QBO experience required, ProAdvisor certification strongly preferred

 • Experience cleaning up and maintaining bookkeeping files (not just inheriting a clean set of books)

 • Full-cycle AR/AP experience including proactive collections follow-up

 • Demonstrated high-volume invoicing experience — accuracy under volume pressure

 • Professional English communication — written and verbal, including client-facing calls

 • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and meet deadlines without reminders

 • Experience supporting US-based businesses



Strongly preferred:

 • Prior experience at a CPA firm, accounting firm, or multi-client bookkeeping service

 • Experience with client-specific invoice templates and contract-based billing

 • Experience managing subcontractor or vendor invoices

 • Familiarity with Limo Anywhere or willingness to learn it quickly

 • Experience supporting small and growing businesses (owner-operator environment)





Schedule & Compensation  ----------------



Full-time, fully remote. Core hours aligned to US Eastern Time, with consistent availability during business hours for client and internal communication. Compensation is structured at full-time equivalent of $12/hr USD, with compensation options, vacation and other benefits discussed transparently in the offer process based on qualifications and experience. A 90-day performance review is standard. 





How to Apply  ----------------



Please apply to this position through our online application.  This gives us a better opportunity to understand your fit for the role.  Any submissions provided through this job site will not be reviewed.  



Apply Here: 



The application includes your basic information, resume upload (cover letter optional), 4 questions.  You will also be able to upload a loom if desired or send it in a follow up
.

title: Head of Ecommerce (Conversion Rate Optimization focused) – Full-Time, Remote
description:

, SMS, and CRM
